Improves stability. 
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Projection Fuse
perks.desc:
Distance optimizations.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.desc: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Grave Robber
perks.desc: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.desc: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Discord
perks.desc: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.desc: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.desc: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Reservoir Burst
perks.desc: When the battery is full, your next burst deals additional damage and causes enemies to explode on death.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.desc: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

perks.name: Cornered
perks.desc: Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.desc: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

perks.name: Willing Vessel
perks.desc: Dealing damage or defeating targets with this weapon gradually grants increased stability, handling, reload speed, and charge rate. This effect gradually decreases over time but is gained more quickly while near allies.

perks.name: Runneth Over
perks.desc: Reloading near allies overflows the magazine. Bows receive faster draw time and Swords receive faster charge rate.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Afteright is an interesting fusion rifle. It doesn't do much that Loaded Question or other fusions can't do. Destabilizing Rounds *with* Reservoir Burst would have been fun. But they're in the same column." Recommended MW: Charge Time.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "In the crucible you can find decent success with this archetype. It's actually one of my favorites. Under Pressure is still the best in slot perk. Paired with Adagio or Successful Warm-Up for benefits post kill." Recommended MW: Range or Charge Time.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 135 from 25 March 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/5JwIN3avdyW27aRjv4Zb2D?si=21b247e788174887) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-MajorSpec PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for burst damage against Elites Champions and Minibosses in both end-game underlevelled or general at-level or better content. If you're still looking for a decent void fusion rifle (and one that looks good too), then Afterlight is an option worth considering. At base, the stats are in-band - 31 Range and 15 Zoom equates to 15.58m ADS and 11.98m hipfire, 39 Stability is ×1.1214 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 31 Handling is 0.45s ready, 0.36s ADS and 0.36s stow speed, 39 Reload Speed is a 2.15s reload, Recoil Direction is 52 and magazine size is 6 (max 8). With 0/1/2/3 reserves mods, total ammo is 21/24/26/28 (max 28). Use the barrel perk to straighten up the Recoil Direction and a little extra handling with the barrel perk. For the battery perk, add extra shots or there's always Liquid Coils and Accelerated Coils to improve damage or charge time. Building into Reservoir Burst, for a ×1.25 damage boost when the battery is full or overflowed, plus the explosion when killing an enemy, the Runneth Over origin trait is excellent, overfilling your battery by an additional 10% (rounded up) for each Guardian you're within 15m of. In addition, in the first column, look for trait perks that either overfill the battery more or help keep it topped up - Ambitious Assassin to overflow up to ×2 depending on the number of rapid kills before reloading, Discord to refund ammo from thin air on kills for 7s after getting a kill with another weapon, or Grave Robber to refill the battery from reserves on an elemental melee hit or melee kill. Alternatively, Lead From Gold helps with ammo economy. Recommended MW: Charge Time or Handling, with an Adept Backup Mag mod (if the battery is already max capacity then Quick Access Sling) or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Void Breaches or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.
